newsitem.title: USA: Toro to buy landscape equipment maker.
newsitem.headline: Toro to buy landscape equipment maker.

text.p: Toro Co, which makes lawnmowers and snowthrowers, on Wednesday said it signed a letter of intent to acquire Exmark Manufacturing Co Inc, a manufacturer of equipment for the professional landscape contractor industry.
Exmark, headquartered in Beatrice, Nebraska., employs about 190 people in a 164,000-square-foot facility. It expects 1997 sales of about $50 million.
Terms of the proposed acquisition were not announced.
Toro said the acquisition would expand its product line at a time when the landscape contractor market is growing and demanding a wider array of products and services.
Shares of Toro were off 3/8 to 36-7/8 late Wednesday afternoon.
